name: @atlasauth/pca-site
description: PCA Intent Layer v2 site adoption kit: access tiers 0-4 with presets, a framework-neutral site guard combining Web Bot Auth (RFC 9421) identification, requirePCA accountability, intent-bound checks with intent_required problems, and dispute-grade evidence/bond gating; drop-in adapters for Express, Fastify, Hono, Next.js and Web Fetch runtimes; agent-side tier selection and graceful degradation.
